6724.title: Request progress is excluded from the gate deadline
6724.rootCauseOneLine: A fixed arrival-time timer spans uploading and origin response waiting without observing upload progress or tunnel presence.
6724.proposedFix: Track upload inactivity and forwarding completion, then extend connected-tunnel head waits under main's existing ten-minute cap.
6724.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout with real frp; Fly staging and public proxy limits were not retested. Reproduction code and output are inline under the reports repository policy.
